examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The run as the home page places it: five solution areas, every picture at the closing end, each band linking to its solution page. Edit the props in the Controls panel — switch `kind` to `alternating`, or set a `title` to open the run with a header.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Both layouts stacked: the `media-end` run of solution areas with no header, then the `alternating` run of network claims under its centered header, the pictures swapping sides band by band.

examples.name: Product media
examples.summary: Bands whose pictures show the product itself: a ProductWidget console screen (`widget`), which plays its beat while the pointer is over the band, a Diagram request flow (`diagram`), and an object picture set whole on its own plate (`imageFramed`). Widget and diagram load only when a band uses them.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import g2Symbol from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/g2-symbol-color.svg'
  import MediaSplitStack from '@aziontech/webkit/media-split-stack'

  const bands = [
    {
      widget: 'data-stream-source',
      title: 'Unified data collection',
      description:
        'Collect event data from Applications, Functions, WAF Events, and Activity History from one configuration.',
      action: { label: 'Learn more', href: '/en/products/data-stream/' }
    },
    {
      diagram: 'load-balancer',
      title: 'Failover and error handling',
      description:
        'Route around an unhealthy origin in real time, and retry on the next one before the request fails.',
      action: { label: 'Learn more', href: '/en/products/load-balancer/' }
    },
    {
      image: g2Symbol,
      imageAlt: 'G2',
      imageFramed: true,
      title: 'Recognized by the people who use it',
      description: 'Rated a Leader in Edge Computing by G2 users, season after season.',
      action: { label: 'Read the reviews', href: '/en/about-us/' }
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <MediaSplitStack
    kind="alternating"
    :bands="bands"
  />
</template>
